title: Setup Users: with SSO-only mode on, Set Password is offered on an IdP-provisioned user and then refused
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmT2NE3iyG1o6TDg3sf

Filing gate: ③ review#2's nit N3 on PR #34124 (record 6902922670), carried as out of scope by the #34010/#34130 dev (os-dev-report 6904842273, carrier: seat). Class a: read in code, not run.
Reader: `domain:ui` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`, the `set_user_password` action's `visible`), reading the server's identity-source rule in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/sso-only-local-password.ts`. Grade suggestion: p3. Only SSO-only deployments see it, and the server already refuses the write.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open set_user_password sso`, `SSO-only Set Password offered`: none.
Related: #34130 (PR #34124 removed `set_user_password`'s admin-plugin gate).

## 维护者速读

开启「仅 SSO 登录」模式后，Setup 用户列表里由身份提供方预置（IdP-provisioned）的用户行仍会显示「设置密码」按钮，但服务端会拒绝这个操作。按钮显示与否没有考虑用户的身份来源，管理员点了只会得到一个拒绝提示。

## Facts (read on main after #34119, and on PR #34124 head `a2f47bbd`)

- `admin-user-endpoints.ts` (about line 1166, `judgeSsoOnlyLocalPassword`): with SSO-only mode on, setting a password for an IdP-provisioned target is refused. Only the narrow break-glass case in `sso-only-local-password.ts` passes.
- `sys_user.set_user_password`'s `visible` has no identity-source term, so the action is offered on those rows.
- A pending SSO user (`pending-sso-marker.ts`) is refused the same way. Check whether `visible` already hides that case.

## Ask

1. Offer Set Password only where the server would accept it: hide it on a row the SSO-only rule refuses, using the same facts the door reads (SSO-only mode, the row's identity source), not a re-derived copy of the rule. If the facts are not visible to the action predicate today, say so and propose the smallest way to expose them.
2. Pins: with SSO-only mode on, an IdP-provisioned row does not offer the action; CONTROL: a local-password row still offers it, and with SSO-only mode off every row keeps today's offer. Ablate red.

⛔ Not a claim.
